recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to timezone or tz-code StructureDefinition metadata should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack; only revisit the name/title wording there if a work-group decision overrides the later TimezoneCode/Timezone Code and FHIR-43351 description.
issue_request: FHIR-23817 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core datatype issue for R5 requesting that the R4 tz-code extension be renamed to timezone, with name/title and description changes to distinguish a named IANA time zone from a numeric time offset.
initial_application: Core commit 5cbc14c7d0f361941099bf72066b75c3f74f6d4f listed FHIR-23817 in the R5 MnM batch and changed source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml from tz-code to timezone. Later core commits normalized extension name/title fields to TimezoneCode/Timezone Code, added related context, and then removed extension definitions from active R5 core source.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini has no active timezone extension-definition entry, and current FHIR-core source only references http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/timezone from datatype narrative, examples, and the OID registry. The FHIR Extension Pack includes input/definitions/* as an IG resource path, contains the active StructureDefinition-timezone.xml, and carries a retired/deprecated StructureDefinition-tz-code.json pointing to StructureDefinition/timezone. Later FHIR-38006 and FHIR-43351 clarified time-zone-code versus time-offset wording and the active extension description.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source was changed. The combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit documenting that the authoritative source for the extension is now in the FHIR Extension Pack and already represents the approved rename.
